notes.title: Officially started Vietnamese support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/4aaca1313f086938d04c8b42f8a928196d401434.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

We just released a Beyond Eden: Dear Edward 1.3.0 version.
From this version you can play the game in Vietnamese.
Thanks the [url=https://x.com/the_circus_team]Rạp Xiếc[/url] for the wonderful work!

This means that starting today, both Beyond Eden and Beyond Eden: Dear Edward will be playable in Vietnamese!! To celebrate the addition of the new language to the game, there’s a 30% off sale on Steam.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/632800/Beyond_Eden/]Beyond Eden (Store page)[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202580/Beyond_Eden_Dear_Edward/]Beyond Eden: Dear Edward (Store page)[/url]

Steam sale ends 14 May.

Also, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202580/Beyond_Eden_Dear_Edward/]demo version[/url] is also available in Vietnamese from now on!

notes.title: 1.3.0 Beta - Vietnamese translation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/4d7da7f3276f75da5a2c540b65d780c27c4f57dc.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We just released a Beyond Eden: Dear Edward 1.3.0 beta version with Vietnamese applied.
(Thanks to Rạp Xiếc for great working on the Vietnamese translation!)

In this beta test, anyone who owns a Beyond Eden: Dear Edward in the Steam library can participate.

You can play the beta version by following the steps below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/64e4e3321bdf6834bbee396941a43328bb90e875.jpg[/img]

After the open beta, Beyond Eden: Dear Edward 1.3.0 will be officially released on April 30th (local time in Vietnam). A Steam Sale will also be held at that time!


You can report bug or typo or unnatural sentences [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1202580/discussions/0/4420805388071585319/]here[/url].


[i][b]Note :[/b][/i]
We recommend that you start playing again after erasing all existing save data.
Before starting the beta version, delete both save folders below.

A. Local data
~/steamapps/common/Beyond Eden Dear Edward/game/saves

B. Persistent data
Windows: %APPDATA%/Roaming/RenPy/beyond_eden_de/
Mac OS X: ~/Library/RenPy/beyond_eden_de/

notes.title: New Episode and Ending Update!

We just released Beyond Eden: Dear Edward 1.2.0 - a update that adds new episode and ending.

[list]
[*] Added new special episode "Bathroom Mystery"
[*] Added new ending graphic for Francis, "Days of Exploration"[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where scroll bars were not displayed in some categories of Achievements
[*] Fixed some unnatural sentences (You can report typo or unnatural sentences [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1202580/discussions/0/4420805388071585319/]here[/url]) [/list]

We hope you will enjoy a delightful Victorian life at Lane hall!

notes.title: Boys love game set in the Victorian era
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Do you like deep narrative Boys love game? 
Do you like the romance and dramatic feelings of British historical drama? 
Do you like complex and realistic chemistry between attractive male characters? 
Finally, the most important question. Are you over 18 years old? 

If so, we recommend our games to you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/c19fb88895ae1c8d6fc03b06a6de2d856ac46b2a.png[/img]
"Beyond Eden" is a [b]Boys love visual novel set in the Victorian era[/b], centering on the themes of [b]love-hate and revenge[/b]. As protagonist Alex, the player may proceed to destroy an aristocratic family while pursuing complex relationships with 6 different male characters. 
([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/632800/Beyond_Eden/]Now Available On Steam[/url]) 

And, there are games we are developing now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/04cd78e6f4eb1944d7e8e7a2080715d836bc0f83.png[/img]
"Beyond Eden" spin-off "Beyond Eden: Dear Edward" is a [b]Boys Love Raising Sim[/b] centered on Edward, the callow young aristocrat from the previous game.
Live in London in the 1890s as a detective, [b]enjoy romance and love triangle[/b] with two love interests.
([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202580/Beyond_Eden_Dear_Edward/]The Demo is Now Available On Steam[/url])

Stay tuned for the full version scheduled for release in 2020 on Steam!

notes.title: The Demo is Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/67c3664c5e8d198249bd21df2b0d2419e63cb18a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38667083/25f7f8a8aca75639743d4ccdde11721825f94ef4.png[/img]

We just released a demo of the our new game, "Beyond Eden: Dear Edward"!

"Beyond Eden" spin-off "Beyond Eden: Dear Edward" is a [b]Boy's Love Raising Sim[/b] centered on Edward, the callow young aristocrat from the previous game.
Follow Edward’s progress as he moves to London staggering under a pile of debt, strives to pay it off and surprisingly find love along the way.

Stay tuned for the full version scheduled for release in 2020 on Steam!
